section: How to Use Listings on a Portfolio Site
text:
How to Use Listings on a Portfolio Site

Organize work by topic:

Tag entries by tool or theme (e.g., R, SQL, GA4, Case-31, CEP) so visitors can scan what you built.

Keep a landing feed:

Use a grid, default, or table listing layout to spotlight recent analyses or coursework artifacts cleanly.

Scale without clutter:

Add new .qmd or .md items to a folder and let the listing update automatically on render.

title: Extending Quarto Websites with CSS & SCSS
text:
CSS (Cascading Style Sheets):

Controls exact visual rules (colors, spacing, borders, typography, card/callout styling) across rendered HTML pages.

SCSS (Sassy CSS):

Extends CSS with variables, nesting, and partials, making theme customization cleaner and easier to maintain when paired with Quarto themes or custom styling rules.

title: Extending Quarto Websites with CSS & SCSS
text:
Practical Ways to Apply Them

Custom .css file (styles.css): Link via format: html: css: styles.css in _quarto.yml for targeted tweaks (such as custom callout borders or spacing).
SCSS variables & rules: Define color/font variables once and reuse them consistently across headings, callouts, and components without repeating hex codes.
Scoped classes: Add {.highlight-box} to specific blocks in .qmd so styles apply only where needed.
